title: Operations Manager
description:
**PORTWEST**, a leading global manufacturer of safety wear, workwear and PPE is currently seeking applications for the position of **Operations Manager** of our factory in **Cumilla, Bangladesh**on a permanent basis, reporting to Production Manager, Asia. Founded in 1904, Portwest has become one of the fastest growing workwear companies in the world currently employing over 6,000 staff worldwide. With 1400 styles across more than 20 ranges, we design, manufacture and distribute market leading workwear, safety wear and PPE in fully owned production facilities. We're on a mission to become the world's most requested PPE and Safety Wear Brand.  

  

**JOB SUMMARY:**

Eastport Limited is a premier, high\-capacity RMG manufacturing facility located in Cumilla, Bangladesh. With a dedicated workforce of over 2,700 employees, we specialize in producing world\-class workwear and safety wear tailored for highly demanding markets across Europe and the USA. We are seeking a dynamic, result\-oriented, and experienced Operations Manager to spearhead our plant operations, drive operational excellence, and sustain our global growth

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* **End\-to\-End Factory Operations:** Oversee complete, end\-to\-end plant manufacturing processes, optimizing overall workflow efficiency.
* **Production \& Supply Chain Integration:** Supervise and coordinate functional units including PP Sampling, Cutting, Finishing, and Fabrics \& Trims Stores to ensure seamless production flow.
* **On\-Time Delivery \& Right\-First\-Time Quality:** Guarantee complete alignment with strict buyer specifications to hit on\-time shipments with zero quality compromises.
* **Financial \& Operational Metrics:** Drive critical efficiency indicators including Cost Per Minute (CPM) monitoring and optimizing direct\-to\-indirect labor ratios.
* **Continuous Improvement \& Lean Culture:** Establish, champion, and cultivate a robust lean manufacturing culture focused on continuous waste reduction and process improvement.
* **Workforce Management:** Implement employee engagement frameworks to sustain a stable, productive workforce and maintain low employee turnover rates.
* **Global Trade Compliance:** Ensure unconditional factory compliance with international statutory laws, buyer codes of conduct, safety mandates, and technical guidelines.
* **Talent Development:** Actively mentor, coach, and upgrade the technical and operational competencies of junior management teams.


**REQUIREMENTS:**


* **Industry Experience:** Proven leadership track record as an Operations Manager or a Senior Production Manager inside a large\-scale RMG factory (minimum 2,500\+ workforce scale).
* **Product Knowledge:** Deep, practical technical expertise in heavy woven, functional workwear, or industrial safety wear garments meant for European and US buyer networks.
* **Analytical Capabilities:** Solid quantitative control over plant KPIs, including line balancing, capacity planning, CPM calculations, and labor matrix analysis.
* **Interpersonal \& Leadership Style:** Exceptional leadership capability capable of driving multi\-tier teams, managing large labor workforces, and negotiating across organizational lines.
* **Postgraduate Degree (Preferred):** Master of Business Administration (MBA) with a concentration in Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, or Human Resource Management is highly desirable.
* **Professional Certifications:** Certifications in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt), or advanced Production Management frameworks will be considered a significant advantage.


\#LI\-NA1

 **COMPANY** **AWARDS**


* Great Place To Work 2024
* Private Irish Business of the year – Export Industry Awards 2025
* Silver Ecovadis Sustainability Rating 2025

  



Applicants must have a right to live and work in the relevant jurisdiction.

title: Kitchen Operations Supervisor
description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced and responsible Kitchen Operations Supervisor to oversee the day\-to\-day operations of our kitchen and food\-service activities.

The candidate will be responsible for coordinating kitchen staff, monitoring food preparation and service, maintaining quality and hygiene standards, managing inventory, and ensuring that daily operations run smoothly and efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Supervise the day\-to\-day kitchen operations and ensure smooth workflow.
* Coordinate kitchen staff and allocate duties according to daily requirements.
* Monitor food preparation, portioning, presentation, and timely service.
* Ensure food is prepared and served according to prescribed quality and hygiene standards.
* Monitor proper storage and handling of raw materials and prepared food.
* Check inventory levels and coordinate with the purchase team for timely replenishment.
* Monitor wastage and help maintain efficient use of food materials.
* Ensure kitchen equipment, work areas, utensils, and service areas are properly maintained and cleaned.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, sanitation, temperature control, and hygiene procedures.
* Maintain and monitor operational records, checklists, and daily logs.
* Coordinate with client representatives regarding daily food\-service requirements.
* Handle operational issues and escalate important matters to management.
* Ensure adequate manpower and resources are available during breakfast, lunch, dinner, and other scheduled services.
* Support management in maintaining consistent food quality and service standards.

**Key Requirements**

* Minimum 2–3 years of experience in kitchen operations, catering, institutional food service, hotel, restaurant, or similar industry.
* Experience supervising kitchen staff and managing day\-to\-day food\-service operations.
* Good understanding of food hygiene, food safety, sanitation, and kitchen practices.
* Ability to manage manpower and coordinate multiple operational activities.
* Good knowledge of inventory, wastage control, and basic food\-cost practices.
* Strong communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage high\-volume food\-service operations.
* Willingness to work according to operational requirements, including weekends or holidays when required.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager Operations
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.  

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Manager Operations****.****In this role, you will:*** Asset Servicing team is part of the Markets and Securities Services Operations functions. AS team processes all voluntary and mandatory corporate action (including Income processing) across various UK, Europe and MENA jurisdiction.
* The department is also responsible for data validation for Equity and UK income collectives and capital mandatory corporate action. Team is divided into mainly three sub\-groups \- corporate action team (processes all capital voluntary \& mandatory corporate action), Income processing team (processes for Dividend, Coupon interest payment \& Pool factor processing) and corporate action validation team (validates corporate action for Equity, UK Income collectives, Capital mandatory corporate action).
* Ensure high\-quality service to the business area in terms of funds ensuring that risks are minimized and profit is maximized through effective management of costs. Ensure that process and procedures are continually reviewed and improved and the changes are communicated and implemented effectively. The job also entails checking on internal audits and measures undertaken and regularly reviews them in order to maintain quality and productivity at the optimum level.
* Responsible for managing performance and deliveries of funds/client sign offs to valuation teams. Contribution towards sustainable savings in relation to Process Efficiencies
* Supporting each global product on a regional basis by function or market. To plan for standardization of Asset Servicing processes by sharing the best practices across the various markets with the aim to enhance cost effectiveness and efficiencies.
* Role will be of individual contributor in nature and will not have team reporting to the role. Continually assess the risks inherent in department processes and procedures.
* High level variation and specific manual processes required by Product/System/Client/jurisdiction/ client
* To be aware of the Operational Risk scenario associated with the role and to ensure that all actions during your employment with HSBC take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring. Ensure effective escalation process is in place.

 **To be successful, you will:*** Bachelor’s degree in commerce or qualifications in accounting/finance industry or relevant experience. Detailed understanding of single sub\-process, control points, end to end process risk.
* Excellent knowledge in accounting principles and fundamentals of accounting. Excellent knowledge of ICON/Geneva/Multifonds as accounting system.
* Excellent knowledge and relevant experience in Asset Servicing with clear understanding of the E2E Fund Accounting Model.
* Basic knowledge in custody, brokerage, depository, investment accounting, mutual funds and reconciliations.
* 3\-5 years of relevant Funds administration experience. Excellent Team Management skills with ability to handle personnel issues and strong team bonding.
* Efficient Time Management and ability to multitask work and priorities to meet defined deadlines. Ability to build excellent rapport and working relationships with other departments and jurisdiction thus ensuring smooth operations.
* Should have demonstrated behavior in line with HSBC values throughout. Strong working knowledge on MS Office
* Will be expected to maintain HSBC internal control standards, including the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, together with any issues raised by external regulators. Must be aware of the operational risk scenarios associated with this role and act upon pertinent risk (if any).

 **You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**

title: Property Operations Executive – Housekeeping & Guest Management
description:
**About the Role**

Renteel is seeking an energetic, detail\-oriented **Property Operations Executive** to oversee on\-ground property management across our Short\-Term Rentals (STRs) and Paying Guest (PG) units.

In this role, you will be the single point of contact for daily operations—ensuring top\-tier cleanliness, smooth guest check\-ins/check\-outs, and rapid resolution of property issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Guest Handling \& Check\-Ins:** Coordinate guest arrivals, conduct smooth check\-ins and key handovers, handle identity verifications, and serve as the direct contact for guest requests during their stay.
* **Housekeeping \& Cleanliness Standards:** Directly supervise or execute property turnover between bookings, ensuring linen changes, deep cleaning, and hotel\-grade presentation.
* **Inventory \& Supplies:** Monitor and restock guest amenities, cleaning supplies, and essential toiletries across all managed properties.
* **Maintenance Coordination:** Inspect units regularly for electrical, plumbing, or appliance issues and coordinate swift repairs with local technicians.
* **PG Facility Management:** Ensure regular upkeep of common areas, timely utility checks, and enforce house rules for long\-term PG residents.

**Requirements \& Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 1 to 2 years in hospitality operations, boutique guest houses, short\-term rentals, or PG management.
* **Ownership Mindset:** Ability to work independently and manage property turnovers without constant supervision.
* **Communication**: Courteous and professional interpersonal skills in local language and basic English/Hindi for guest handling.
* **Mobility:** Must have a valid two\-wheeler and driving license for local site\-to\-site travel.
* **Availability:** Flexible schedule, including weekends and public holidays when check\-ins are peak.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
